profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Kyndryl
profile.summary: Technically adept Senior Software Engineer with 9+ years of experience designing, programming, coding, testing, and deploying highly functional tools & applications. Proven ability to lead technical teams, collaborate cross-functionally, define functional requirements, and develop innovative software-based solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Led the design and development of a new feature projects, engaging in extensive detailed planning and 
team-oriented implementation to deliver all work on time in healthcare business following HIPAA
•	Proposed, gained buy-in for, and spearheaded project to refactor a .Net API into a better, more 
maintainable architecture based in RESTful practices, expediting future deployments by 30%
•       Integrated Agentic AI into a healthcare application, leading two junior engineers in designing and developing an MCP server.
•	Developed new Azure pipeline jobs in YAML to automatically test and deploy new APIs regularly, 
achieving 100% test coverage of endpoints
•	Promoted cohesion and collaboration by utilizing Agile methodologies serving as Scrum Master, 
resulting in 20% development speed increase
•	Enhanced tech capabilities by coaching 3 Engineers in Angular & .Net development and debugging 
•	Designed architecture of new .Net REST API following RESTful best practices
•	Made broad improvements to our Angular web app front-end
•	Added new UI elements to our Windows Forms front-end software
•	Upgraded our Angular and .Net codebases to newer major versions of their respective frameworks
•	Created numerous end-to-end tests for our Angular front-end using Cypress, integration tests for our APIs using Postman, and unit tests on NUnit
•	Took the role of one of the only two people in our department able to use InstallShield to modify our software installers
positions.insights: Skills: HTML5 · Business Applications · Full-Stack Development · Microsoft Visual Studio Code · InstallShield · Entity Framework · .NET Core · API Development · Continuous Integration (CI) · AngularJS · Representational State Transfer (REST) · Angular 16 · Microsoft Azure · C# in .NET · Healthcare · RESTful WebServices

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
• Developed front-end web applications for Sears, KMart, and Shop Your Way eCommerce, SPA sites 
that enhanced the UI/UX, utilizing JavaScript Angular, HTML, and CSS with precision
• Collaborated with a geographically distributed Software Engineering team of 20+ members and worked 
cross-functionally with UI/UX, Product, Back-end, and QA teams to deploy new tools and features
• Optimized UI features for desktop, mobile, and responsive versions of the websites, resulting in greater 
responsiveness and reliability for an estimated 3,000,000+ end-users and customers
• Saved 100+ engineering hours by automating team release notes with an innovative Java-coded tool
• Reduced demand on Software Engineers’ time by implementing a user-friendly system enabling direct 
editing of Sears website by those without programming knowledge
• Utilized Agile Scrum development with Jira, Jenkins, Git version-control, and NodeJS
• Developed user interface using REST APIs through Angular
• Migrated large amount of UI web content from AngularJS to Angular 6 to modernize websites
• Automated performance analysis of Sears website
positions.insights: Skills: Business Applications · Mobile Application Development · AngularJS · Representational State Transfer (REST)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Worked with front-end web development team using AngularJS, HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap
• Created reusable accordion UI directive for use throughout the entire website
• Created reusable mutton UI directive for use throughout the entire website
• Eliminated 3000 lines of old, unnecessary code with streamlining and bug fixing
• Utilized Agile Scrum development with Jira, Git version-control, and NodeJS
•	Utilized agile Scrum development

positions.title: Software Engineering Student
positions.description:
• Implemented front-end UI using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery
• Programmed back-end in PHP, and communicated with it using JavaScript AJAX and JSON
• Added, pulled, edited, and deleted data from MySQL database using SQL

company.name: Web Applications course, CISE, University of Florida

positions.title: Software Engineering Student
positions.description:
• Created Visual Studio Plugin using C# to provide front-end UI for application
• Semi-automated the translation of serial code into parallel code to run it faster in GPUs
• Demonstrated working program on stage in front of Lockheed Martin engineers
• Built test computer with Nvidia GPU to test application

positions.title: Software Engineering Student
positions.description:
• Designed front-end UI in Photoshop
• Worked together with a group of 7 other team members to design a Unity 3D game
• Programmed behavior of enemies using C#
• Utilized Agile Scrum development with Git version-control
